exact: modulation by symbiont of host programmed cell death
narrow: modulation by symbiont of host non-apoptotic programmed cell death

definition: A process in which a symbiont gene product alters or subverts host programmed cell death, leading to a change in the frequency, rate or extent of host programmed cell death in the host cell. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.
label: symbiont-mediated perturbation of host programmed cell death
